title: HELIX Bridge: Workday Financial Management → AccountsReceivable / Student Financials
architecture_notes: Workday handles student financials through Customer Invoices and Customer Payments. In Workday Student, tuition charges flow as Customer Invoices auto-generated by the academic enrollment process. Refunds are handled as Customer Refunds. Third-party billing (e.g., employer tuition reimbursement) uses Customer Contracts. Student account balances are derived from the AR subledger. Institutions using Workday Student get native integration; those running a separate SIS (Banner, PeopleSoft) feed charges via integration.

source_objects.description: Invoice to a student or external entity. Header: customer (student), invoice date, due date, total, status. Equivalent to PS_ITEM/PS_ITEM_LINE (student financials) or PS_BI_HDR/PS_BI_LINE (billing).
Line items: charge type (tuition, fees, room, board, etc.), amount, worktag coding (revenue category, fund, cost center). Equivalent to PS_ITEM_LINE_DTL.
Payment received: check, ACH, credit card, financial aid disbursement, third-party payment. Equivalent to PS_PAYMENT_TBL (student financials).
Refund to student (excess financial aid, dropped course refund). Equivalent to PS_REFUND_HDR.
Customer master. For student financials, the student is the customer. May also include external sponsors, employers, government agencies.
Third-party billing agreements (employer tuition reimbursement, VA benefits, tribal agreements). Equivalent to PS_THIRD_PARTY_CONTRACT.

attribute_mappings.transformation: Resolve customer to HELIX student_id. In Workday Student, Customer = Student record.
Map: Customer Invoice → 'charge', Customer Payment → 'payment', Customer Refund → 'refund', Credit Memo → 'adjustment'.
Map Workday Revenue Category to HELIX charge code. E.g., 'Tuition - Undergraduate' → 'tuition_ug'.

attribute_mappings.source: Customer Invoice Line.Extended_Amount or Customer Payment.Payment_Amount

attribute_mappings.transformation: Link to HELIX AcademicPeriod. Institutions typically code tuition charges to an academic period.
Direct map. Remaining balance after payments applied.
If charge is covered by a third-party contract, reference the contract.

notes: Student financial data is FERPA-protected (education records) and may contain GLBA-covered elements when linked to financial aid. Classify as confidential at minimum; restricted when linked to FAFSA/tax data.
